title: checkout 5xx from payment-gateway pool exhaustion (v2.3.0)
root_cause: payment-gateway HikariCP connection pool (max=20) saturated under sale traffic after v2.3.0, causing checkout POST /checkout calls to time out and return 500s.
summary: Raised payment-gateway pool to 50 and added a circuit breaker on checkout→payment-gateway; error rate recovered within 4 minutes.

title: checkout-service high error rate due to payment-gateway connection pool exhaustion
root_cause: payment-gateway HikariCP connection pool (max=20) saturated, causing checkout POST /checkout calls to time out and return errors.
summary: Increase payment-gateway connection pool size and add circuit breaker on checkout→payment-gateway; error rate will recover.

title: search-service high p99 latency due to CPU saturation
root_cause: search-service pods are CPU saturated (container_cpu_usage ~98%), causing local ranking compute to slow down and p99 latency to exceed 2s.
summary: Scale up search-service CPU resources or optimize ranking compute; add alert on CPU usage >90% for 5m.

title: cart-service error rate spike after deploy (NullPointerException)
root_cause: NullPointerException at CartController.applyCoupon (line 88) introduced in v2.4.1 deploy.
summary: Immediate rollback of v2.4.1 or hotfix to handle null in applyCoupon; error rate will recover.

title: product-service p99 latency spike due to cache miss storm
root_cause: product-service is serving requests via a cache miss path, resulting in 12 sequential postgres reads per request and tripled p99 latency.
summary: Investigate and restore cache effectiveness for product-service; optimize query pattern to avoid sequential DB reads on cache miss.

title: payment-service p99 latency spike due to Stripe API slowness
root_cause: External dependency (Stripe API) latency spiked, causing payment-service requests to time out.
summary: Monitor Stripe API latency and implement fallback/retry logic to handle external slowness.
